note: 26 Lattice Gas random starts (#172, stacked on #171; the #165 grade 'random starting configurations', VIZ research's ruling): a random seed per load (QA pins seed=1, the classic opening), 5 flow starts (vortices, shear, dipoles, jets, splash) x 4 dyes (bands, checker, rings, blobs) from the seed, a new seeded dye faded in over 1 bar at each drop. Start truths on the CPU, one variant per flow start (seed 1, flow fixed, opening at bar 0 = the fluid view): S1 max |u| <= 0.2 and mean momentum 0 (exact on the particles), S2 RMS |u| >= 0.05 and one beat moves the dye picture >= 10 % (report-only on splash), S3 div/curl < 0.05 (not splash), S4 same seed same lattice and the next seed a different start. Swipe: the start variants vs #171 (always vortices). Everything below is #171's look round, unchanged: faster mixing in F2 (#165 6561994762: 16 vortex modes at |u| <= 0.18, a solenoidal Kolmogorov force in the fluid view, kick stirs 1.8x, macro4 mix speed = the dye's time-lapse 1-6x (3x), up to 96 steps a beat) and splash contrast in F1 (#71 6562177939: macro3 splash contrast 0.8, dots 20 % and desaturated, the 4x4-block density excess over the mean lit in a hot hue per burst, bursts 2x). Truth 4's vortex replicas carry the forcing (amp 0.004). T5 (report-only): dye block-variance half-time in bars at the default mix, frozen flow (check().t5) and live after the drop on default (__qa.mixLive(), the number that matters); T6 (gated): 1x / 6x half-time >= 3. ?qa=splash (F1, no kicks): a burst every 2 beats in the middle, knob cycling default / 0 / 1, measured 1 beat later: C1 ring / median (report-only, >= 4 wanted), C2 median (report-only, <= 0.05 wanted), C3 knob 1 / 0 (gated, >= 2), N1 ring annulus >= 0.5 at the default knob (report-only; #171 ruling: C2 wins at splash contrast >= 0.5, so the frame-mean >= 0.15 target is retired for F1 there and lumSteady on F1 / splash is informational). GPU budget: shared passes on fluid (96 steps a beat + forcing) and F1 (splash layer) besides the default page. Sparks and F1 zoom moved to detail inputs.
